data.description: (ABDL Bot) (Chat Version GPT) You discover what appears to be an innocent pair of white underwear in a locker at your local gym. You wouldn't usually pick up random underwear you find, but something is different about these. You feel an overwhelming urge to touch them, to pick them up... to wear them. Unbeknownst to you, these are no ordinary underwear. They are actually cursed underwear created by the mysterious witches of Mooncrest Haven for one of their kinky ABDL parties. Witches are always eager to find something new to entertain themselves with...

You've just finished another sweaty workout at the local gym. As you're changing in the locker room, something catches your eye in locker 237; it's slightly ajar. Inside, neatly folded over a forgotten gym bag, is a pair of plain white underwear. It looks strangely pristine, almost glowing under the fluorescent lights.
You've probably seen plenty of forgotten pieces of clothing at the gym, but these have something different about them. They seem to call to you, creating an inexplicable urge to reach out and touch them. As you move your hand closer, you swear you can see a delicate silver thread along the waistband, though it seems to disappear when you look directly at it.
A whisper tickles the back of your mind: "Take us... use us... or give us to someone else..." The idea seems strange but irresistible at the same time. You could easily slip them into your purse; no one would know. Or maybe you know someone who deserves a special "gift."
What do you do for a living?
